description: Receiving earnest money and rental deposits into the sales escrow account; giving buyers the escrow wire instructions; confirming title company wire instructions with buyers; disbursing held funds to title companies and landlords; monthly reconciliation
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: A diverted wire is usually lost within hours, so a verified channel must be back within 4 hours on a closing day; deposits must be placed in escrow by the end of the third business day (r. 61J2-14.008(3)); bank records set the RPO
manual_workaround: Phone-only confirmation of wire instructions using numbers from the contract file; deposits by cashier's check delivered in person; postpone any disbursement that cannot be verified by phone
dependent_third_parties: Escrow bank; title companies and closing attorneys; outside bookkeeper
dependent_people_or_facilities: Broker-owner (single point of failure; only escrow signatory)

description: Offers and contracts; disclosures; deadlines (inspection; financing; deposit verification under r. 61J2-14.008(2)(b)); document exchange with clients; lenders; and title companies; e-signatures
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Contract deadlines run in calendar days and a missed one can cost a client the deal; about 20 sales a year with 2 to 4 open at any time; RPO supported by the platform vendor's backups (SOC 2 system description: RPO 1 hour)
manual_workaround: Work from the PDF copies in SYS-02; e-signature service as a fallback for signatures; phone the other agent and title company to confirm deadlines
dependent_third_parties: Transaction platform vendor; e-signature vendor; freelance coordinator

description: Email; calls and texts; MLS listings; showing scheduling; electronic lockbox access; listing descriptions
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Clients and other agents expect same-day replies; listings and showings drive future income; email holds the record of client instructions
manual_workaround: Phone and text from the mobile phone; MLS reached from any browser; showing appointments confirmed by phone
dependent_third_parties: Email provider; MLS and local association; phone carrier

description: Advertising rentals; taking applications; running screening reports; recommending applicants to landlords; signing leases; collecting first month's rent and security deposit
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About 10 placements a year; a vacancy can wait a few days; FCRA and Fair Housing duties apply to every decision, which is why regulatory impact is Moderate
manual_workaround: Hold applications; ask the landlord to extend the listing date; screening can be run again when the service is back

description: Accounting; commission receipts; license renewals and continuing education; insurance; tax records
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deadlines are measured in weeks; the escrow ledger spreadsheet and security documents in SYS-02 have no independent backup today, so the 24-hour RPO is not fully supported
manual_workaround: Use the bank and accounting portals directly; paper copies of the license and insurance declarations in the home office
